candidate.user_submission: Di pikin dey 18 months old. E get cough and dey find am hard to breathe, e get diarrhoea, ear problem, and fever. E no dey convulse now and dem no see any convulsion before. Di pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E dey vomit everything. For di diarrhoea, no blood dey inside di stool. E dey drink normally. E no dey restless or irritable. Di skin pinch dey normal. E eyes no sink. Di diarrhoea don dey for 3 days. Di caregiver talk say ear discharge never happen, e no dey feel ear pain, no pus dey come out from ear, and no tender swelling dey behind ear. Di fever don last 2 days. E no get generalized rash. No identified bacterial cause. Di malaria risk dey high, malaria test dey available and di result na negative. E no get measles cough and e never get measles for di last 3 months. No obvious cause of fever dey. E eyes no red and e nose no dey run. E neck no stiff. Di temperature na 38.0°C. Dem count breaths for one minute. E chest no dey draw inside. Di pikin dey calm. Di cough don last 3 days. Pulse oximeter no dey. E no dey wheeze and no recurrent wheeze dey. No stridor dey when e calm. Di respiratory rate na 35.
